article.title_es: United Methodist Center en Far Rockaway: comedor y despensa
article.title_en: United Methodist Center in Far Rockaway: soup kitchen and pantry
article.summary_es: El United Methodist Center en Far Rockaway, Queens, ofrece comedor de sopa y despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
article.summary_en: The United Methodist Center in Far Rockaway, Queens, offers a soup kitchen and food pantry according to the City's Food Help NYC map.
how_they_help_es: Comedor de sopa: lunes, martes, miércoles, jueves y viernes de 12pm a 1pm, y de 4:30pm a 5:30pm (excepto jueves).
Despensa de alimentos: martes y jueves de 9:30am a 11am y de 1pm a 4pm.
Está ubicado en 1032 Beach 19th St, Far Rockaway, NY 11691.
Puede llamar al (718) 327-5071 para preguntar qué alimentos ofrece y si hay requisitos.
how_they_help_en: Soup kitchen: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday from 12pm to 1pm, and from 4:30pm to 5:30pm (except Thursday).
Food pantry: Tuesday and Thursday from 9:30am to 11am and from 1pm to 4pm.
Located at 1032 Beach 19th St, Far Rockaway, NY 11691.
You can call (718) 327-5071 to ask what food is offered and if there are requirements.
visit_tips_es: Los horarios del comedor y de la despensa son distintos; revise bien antes de ir.
La información fue verificada por última vez el 10 de octubre de 2026.

visit_tips_en: The soup kitchen and pantry hours are different; check carefully before going.
